name: ragbench
description: Score a RAG system against a golden dataset and fail the build when it gets worse. Deterministic metrics, no LLM judge, no API key, no per-run cost. Zero dependencies.

scripts.test: node --test test/metrics.test.mjs test/dataset.test.mjs test/gate.test.mjs test/labels.test.mjs test/cli.test.mjs
